fdroid:com.helddertierwelt.mentalmath.name: Mental Math
fdroid:com.helddertierwelt.mentalmath.summary: Practice mental arithmetic solo or compete with friends.
fdroid:com.helddertierwelt.mentalmath.description:
"Mental Math" is a simple and clean Android app for mental arithmetic training. You can practice on your own or challenge friends to compete and improve your skills. The app is open source and respects your privacy.
Customizable Training
Select which arithmetic operations to include (+, −, ×, ÷). For each operation, choose from nine difficulty levels to customize your training precisely to your skill level.
Three Game Modes
• Practice Mode lets you complete a fixed number of problems (10, 20, 30, 40, or 50).
• Timed Mode challenges you to solve as many problems as possible within a time limit (1, 2, 3, 4, or 5 minutes).
• Survival Mode challenges you to survive 100 problems with 3 lives and a decreasing time limit for each problem.
Challenge your Friends
You can share a game link to:
1. Replay a completed game with the exact same problems to compare scores with friends.
2. Start a new game with preset settings for a fair and fresh challenge for everyone.
Difficulty Calculation
Problem difficulty is determined using algorithms based on column addition, column subtraction, long multiplication, and long division, creating realistic and well-balanced exercises.
Detailed Results
After each game, view a detailed summary that includes your selected settings, your performance (accuracy, speed, and score), and a complete list of all your problems and answers for review.
Personal Leaderboard
Your top 10 results are displayed separately for each combination of settings, allowing you to easily track your progress. You can also review detailed summaries of your top games at any time.
Game History
Explore the complete history of all your scored games. You can sort the list by time or numerically to find specific games. Anytime, you can revisit any match to view a detailed summary of its results.
Practice Reminders
Set up periodic reminders to support regular mental math practice. Notifications are sent in the evening (around 6 p.m.) and can be scheduled daily, every three days, or weekly.
Customizable Interface
Choose your preferred keypad (numeric or phone-style), display math problems horizontally or vertically, and adjust the input direction (left-to-right or right-to-left) to suit your preferences.
Sound & Vibration
Choose sound and/or vibration as feedback during games for clearer, more immediate feedback. Both options can be enabled or disabled independently. Vibration may depend on your device or system settings.
Clean Design
A simple and minimalist app design with no unnecessary elements or distractions, designed to keep your focus fully on mental math training. Supports both light and dark modes.
Open Source, Private, Free & Ad-free
"Mental Math" is fully open source, free to use, and does not contain any ads. It also does not collect, store, or process any personal data, nor does it use trackers or third-party services.

fdroid:com.lpw.graypause.name: GrayPause
fdroid:com.lpw.graypause.summary: Keep your phone in grayscale, take short color breaks that end by themselves
fdroid:com.lpw.graypause.description:
Grayscale makes a phone much less tempting to pick up. The hard part is the moment you need color for a minute — a photo, a map, a chart — and then forget to turn grayscale back on.
 GrayPause gives you color breaks : grayscale switches off for the time you choose and comes back on by itself.
 One-tap timers — 1, 5, 10, 15, 30 min by default. Add your own with hours, minutes and seconds; delete any of them.
 Quick Settings tile — starts a break of the last length you used; tap again to end it early.
 App shortcuts — long-press the launcher icon to start a timer without opening the app.
 Countdown notification with "Grayscale now" and "+5 min" buttons.
 Color apps (optional) — pick apps such as your gallery or camera that are always shown in color. Grayscale switches off while one of them is open and back on when you leave it.
 Survives reboots: a running break is resumed, or grayscale restored if the time is up.
 One-time setup. Android only lets system apps switch grayscale, so GrayPause needs the WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS permission. It cannot be granted from Settings, only once, either:
 with Shizuku running: tap "Grant with Shizuku" in the app, or
 over adb: adb shell pm grant com.lpw.graypause android.permission.WRITE_SECURE_SETTINGS 
 The permission is kept across reboots and updates; Shizuku is not needed afterwards.
 Accessibility service. The optional "Color apps" feature uses an accessibility service only to learn which app is in the foreground. It does not read screen content, and nothing leaves your device: GrayPause has no internet permission.

fdroid:com.saad2134.dosezy.name: Dosezy
fdroid:com.saad2134.dosezy.summary: Track your medications, get timely reminders, and manage your health with ease.
fdroid:com.saad2134.dosezy.description:
Dosezy is an accessible, offline-first medication tracking and reminder app designed for stress-free prescription management. Input your medicines, dosages, and schedules, and Dosezy handles the rest, keeping your health on track with zero privacy compromises.
✨ KEY FEATURES:
• 🔔 Critical Full-Screen Alarms - High-visibility alarm screen rings reliably even in deep sleep or silent mode. Intercept with hardware volume keys to instantly silence audio, or use the back gesture to safely snooze.
• 🎵 Customizable Sound & Duration - Choose custom ringtones or built-in alert tones with in-app audio previews, dedicated alarm volume controls, and adjustable alarm durations (30 seconds to 5 minutes or continuous looping).
• ⏰ Dynamic Snooze & Time Windows - Flexible snooze presets (5, 10, 15, 20, or 30 minutes). Configure custom "Consider Late After" (1-3h) and "Consider Missed After" (3-9h) thresholds with live countdown badges.
• 📝 Clinical Dose Skipping - Opt-in dose skipping with mandatory clinical reasons (doctor advised, adverse reactions, fasting, illness). Skipped doses do not penalize your adherence streak and can be undone at any time.
• ↩️ Instant Intake Undo - Accidental taps can be reversed immediately with a 5-second undo snackbar or directly from the dose card, restoring deducted stock automatically.
• 📦 Pill Stock Inventory & Refill Warnings - Real-time stock tracking with automatic deduction on intake. Configurable low-stock alerts notify you when it is time to refill prescriptions.
• 🛒 Pharmacy Refill Order Generator - Instantly compile prescription refill orders from your active inventory and low-stock medicines. Calculate required supplies for 15, 30, 60, or 90 days, preview the formatted order, and share directly via chat or copy to clipboard.
• 📅 Interactive Schedule Calendar - Week and month calendar views with color-coded compliance dots and complete TalkBack screen reader accessibility announcing dose statuses.
• 📊 Adherence Analytics - Comprehensive compliance tracking across Today, 7 Days, 30 Days, 90 Days, and All-Time. Multi-ring breakdowns and individual medication adherence rates.
• 🔍 Real-Time Medicine Search - Quickly filter large medication rosters by name or instruction with instant empty-state feedback.
• 👥 Multi-Family Profiles - Manage medicines for multiple family members on one device. Each profile keeps separate medicines, schedules, inventory, and doctor contacts.
• 🔒 Full ZIP Backup & Selective Restore - Export complete encrypted backup archives. Restore individual profiles with granular conflict resolution: Create New, Merge Records, or Replace.
• 📄 Printable Doctor PDF Reports - Generate clean medical adherence reports with active prescriptions, dosages, food instructions, and compliance summaries for appointments.
• 🚨 International Emergency Dialing - 1-tap dialing for official emergency services across 10 regions with auto-detection, plus private personal emergency contacts per profile.
• 🌐 12 Native Languages - Full localization in English, Spanish, Hindi, Chinese, Portuguese, Arabic, French, German, Japanese, Russian, Italian, and Bengali.
• 🛡️ Notification Reliability Shield - Built-in diagnostic tool checks exact alarm permissions, battery optimization, and notification channels with manufacturer-specific setup guides.
• 🔒 100% Private & Offline - No accounts, no sign-ups, no tracking. All medical data stays encrypted locally on your phone.

fdroid:net.christianbeier.droidvnc_ng.name: droidVNC-NG

fdroid:net.christianbeier.droidvnc_ng.description:
Turn your Android device into a remote-controlled workstation with droidVNC-NG, a powerful, open-source VNC server designed for local networks. This app offers a versatile solution for remote access.
 💻 Remote Control & Interaction 
• Screen Sharing: Share your device's screen over the network, with optional scaling on the server side for better performance.
• Remote Control: Use your VNC client to control your device, including mouse and keyboard input. To enable this, you need to activate the AccessibilityService for the app on your device.
• Special Key Functions: Remotely trigger key functions like 'Recent Apps,' Home button, Back button, Power and volume controls.
• Text Copy & Paste: Support for copying and pasting text from your device to the VNC client. Note that server-to-client copy & paste works automatically for text selected in editable text fields or manually by sharing text to droidVNC-NG via Android's Share-To functionality.
• Multiple Mouse Pointers: Display different mouse pointers for each connected client on your device.
 🌴 Comfort Features 
• Web Browser Access: Control your device’s shared screen directly from a web browser, without needing a separate VNC client.
• Auto-Discovery: droidVNC-NG uses Zeroconf/Bonjour for easy discovery by native clients.
 🔐 Security & Configuration 
• Password Protection: Protect your VNC connection with a password. Note that setting a password is mandatory in case you want to access the server using MacOS's built-in Screen Sharing app.
• Custom Port Settings: Choose which port the VNC server uses for connections.
• Startup on Boot: Automatically start the VNC service when your device boots up. On Android 11 and newer this also works with kiosk-mode launchers and lock task mode.
• Default Configuration: Load a default configuration from a JSON file or Mobile Device Management.
 🚀 Advanced VNC Features 
• Reverse VNC: Allow your device to initiate the VNC connection to a client without opening ports on your router.
• Repeater Support: Connect to a repeater that supports UltraVNC-style Mode-2 for more flexible networking.
Please note that more features are still being added to droidVNC-NG. Please report any issues and feature requests at https://github.com/bk138/droidVNC-NG

fdroid:org.astermail.android.name: Aster Mail: Encrypted Email

Your own domain

- Swipe actions and a toolbar you can customize

if you use widget on your phone or tablet, you can see your location and current weather on the main screen. Update of location could be used by some specific period (ex. hourly) or application can use accelerometer to detect movement. You can switch update of location off - weather only is updated in this case.
Update by specific period of time:
Application update the location and weather by specified amount of time. For example, you can set update period to one hour o'clock.
Update by accelerometer:
Location is updated by a distance counted by accelerometer. When distance is longer then minimal value for update, application update your location. Distance derived by accelerometer depends on the way how you carry your phone - when you carry your phone in a pocket the distance is increases faster - the phone is moving back and forth as you go. The weather is updated immediately after the update of location. The weather is updated when screen goes on too - but not more often then once per 15 minutes (and when weather is not updated in the last 15 minutes).
To get the location, cell network (BTS) and WIFIs available on the place are used. These information are used to get location coordinates by Mozilla location service. Application try to use GPS when location is not available from cell network and WIFIs. Location coordinates are used to get address by Nominatim service. The address is used in the application or widget.
Application uses open-meteo.com service to get current weather .

It works using HID over GATT and is compatible with all platforms that accept generic Bluetooth input. This includes the following:
- iOS and iPadOS
- macOS
- tvOS
- Linux (and SteamOS)
- Windows
- ChromeOS
- Other platforms that support Bluetooth input
Since it presents itself as a regular Bluetooth keyboard and mouse (HID over GATT), nothing needs to be installed on the device you control. Pair once from the host's Bluetooth settings and start typing.
It features:
- Trackpad: tap to click, two-finger tap for right click, two-finger scroll, dedicated mouse buttons
- Keyboard: live typing, supports special keys and modifiers keys
- Media: play/pause, rewind, fast-forward, volume controls, mute
Additionally, it allows you to scan nearby devices with signal strength and manufacturer information.
Remote is under the AGPL-3.0 license at https://github.com/jqssun/darwin-bt-remote

apple-macos:1339198386.name: Amadine - Vector Design & Art
apple-macos:1339198386.description:
Professional Vector Design. Made for Mac.
Amadine is a cutting-edge vector graphic design app developed specifically for macOS. With a sleek native interface and a robust toolkit, Amadine delivers a seamless design experience for illustrators, graphic designers, and visual storytellers—whether you're creating intricate artwork or polished branding assets.
From initial sketches to final exports, Amadine on Mac empowers you to design with precision, speed, and creative freedom.
Why Choose Amadine for Mac?
• Comprehensive Vector Toolkit
Draw, edit, and transform with over 30 precision tools for creating illustrations, logos, icons, UI/UX designs, typography, infographics, and more.
• Powerful Layer & Artboard Management
Create and manage complex designs with multiple artboards, layers, and sublayers. Choose from over 15 blending modes and toggle between outline, grid, guides, and pixel preview views.
• Flexible Color Management
Work in both RGB and CMYK color modes. Amadine supports color profiles for accurate on-screen representation and includes a Recolor panel for global changes in one click.
• Customizable Brushes & Dynamic Strokes
Design with multiple strokes and fills per object. Use pressure-sensitive strokes, save your own stroke profiles, and add gradients or image fills with full control over brush width, angle, and shape. Create an evenly spaced outline around any shape or complex path with the Offset Path tool. 
• Advanced Typography Tools
Design expressive text with tools for distortable text, text on paths, and text in shapes. Link multiple text boxes with flowing text and format everything in place.
• Precision Effects & Smart Tools
Add visual polish with blur, shadow, glow, and inner effects. Create advanced compositions with Clipping Masks, Rounded Corners, Fusion tool, Symmetrical and Free Distortion tools.
• Built-In & Custom Shape Libraries
Access a rich collection of ready-made vector shapes, or build your own libraries to speed up your workflow with reusable components. Not enough? Use the integration with Pexels, Pixabay, and Unsplash image stocks.
Image Trace
Vectorize any bitmap image with the Image Trace tool. Select an imported photo or PNG on the canvas, open the Path panel, and tap Trace. Choose Monochrome or Colored mode and fine-tune Brightness Threshold, Number of Colors, Level of Detail and Smoothness to balance accuracy against output complexity. The result is a fully editable set of vector paths.
• Streamlined File Workflow
Open, edit, and save files in Amadine’s efficient .amdc format for easy cloud storage and collaboration. Work with popular formats like SVG, PDF, AI, JPEG, PNG, TIFF, and more.
• Export with Confidence
Export entire documents, individual artboards, or selected elements into vector (SVG, PDF) and raster (JPEG, PNG, TIFF) formats with professional accuracy.
Designed Exclusively for Mac
Amadine is built from the ground up for macOS, offering a stable, powerful environment for vector design with full support for high-resolution displays, system integrations, and performance optimization.
A separate version is available for iPad and iPhone, tailored for mobile creativity. The integration of the macOS and iOS/iPadOS apps is achieved via iCloud.
One-Time Purchase or Subscription
Explore the full feature set with a free app. Unlock export and image trace options with a flexible license—choose between a one-time purchase or subscription. All plans apply to the Mac version specifically.
Master vector design—right on your Mac—with Amadine.

flathub:net.purrdata.PurrData.name: Purr Data
flathub:net.purrdata.PurrData.summary: An open source visual programming language for multimedia, based on Pure Data
flathub:net.purrdata.PurrData.description:
This package contains Purr Data, which is a fork of Pure Data that
 bundles a lot of useful extensions, and brings a modern HTML5-based
 user interface.
 Pure Data is an open source visual programming environment that runs on
 anything from personal computers to embedded devices (ie Raspberry Pi)
 and smartphones (via libpd, DroidParty (Android), and PdParty (iOS).
 It is a major branch of the family of patcher programming languages
 known as Max (Max/FTS, ISPW Max, Max/MSP, etc), originally developed
 by Miller Puckette at IRCAM.
 Pd enables musicians, visual artists, performers, researchers, and
 developers to create software graphically without writing lines of
 code. Pd can be used to process and generate sound, video, 2D/3D
 graphics, and interface sensors, input devices, and MIDI. Pd can
 easily work over local and remote networks to integrate wearable
 technology, motor systems, lighting rigs, and other equipment. It
 is suitable for learning basic multimedia processing and visual
 programming methods as well as for realizing complex systems for
 large-scale projects.

Bluefish is a powerful editor targeted towards programmers and web developers, with many options to write code, scripts and websites. Bluefish supports many programming and markup languages and has many features, but is still a very fast and lightweight application.
 Note that the flatpak version of Bluefish does not integrate well with other tools on your system due to flatpak security restrictions. 
 A selection of the features:
 Well done syntax highlighting which for example supports languages inside languages (e.g. Javascript inside HTML inside PHP)
 All kind of powerful editor features like auto indenting and auto completion for many functions and libraries in many programming languages
 Project support
 Support for remote files over ftp, sftp, webdav, etc
 Powerful multi-file and regex capable search and replace engine
 Customizable integration of external programs such as pylint, make, etc
 Snippets plugin to automate often used code
 Code-aware in-line spell checking
 Zencoding or Emmet support
 Bookmarks
 If you are an occasional coder who is in need for a simple to learn editor, or a heavy coder who dislikes heavy IDE's like eclipse or netbeans, Bluefish is your editor of choice!

Play the highly addictive 2048 game. 2048 is a clone of the popular
 single-player puzzle game. Gameplay consists of joining numbers in a grid
 and obtain the 2048 tile.
 Use your keyboard's arrow keys to slide all tiles in the desired direction.
 Be careful: all tiles slide to their farthest possible positions, you cannot
 slide just one tile or one row or column. Tiles with the same value are
 joined when slided one over the other.
 With every new tile obtained you increase your score. If you think you can easily
 get the 2048 tile, do not let it stop you, the game does not end there, you can
 continue joining tiles and improving your score.
 Originally created by Gabriele Cirulli, 2048 has gained much popularity
 due to it being highly addictive. Cirulli's 2048 is in turn a clone of
 the 1024 game and includes ideas from other clones.

firefox-addons:3047182.summary: Advanced, zero-data-collection privacy protection blocking trackers, Canvas and WebGL fingerprinting, and WebRTC IP leaks.
firefox-addons:3047182.description:
SUP (Super Ultimate Privacy) is a high-performance privacy extension designed to shield your online identity, block intrusive telemetry, and prevent cross-site tracking without breaking website layouts or functionality.
Built with a zero-data-collection philosophy, all processing occurs locally on your browser.
Key Features:
• Declarative Net Request (DNR) Blocker: Intercepts and blocks tracking domains, intrusive analytics scripts, and third-party trackers (Google Analytics, Facebook Pixel, Hotjar, Mixpanel, and more) at the network level.
• Non-Destructive Anti-Canvas Fingerprinting: Dynamically introduces subtle, offscreen noise into Canvas rendering methods (getImageData, toDataURL, toBlob), disrupting visual fingerprinting without breaking site UI, image editors, or QR code generators.
• WebGL & Hardware Masking: Spoofs WebGL GPU vendor/renderer strings via extension proxies while restricting system hardware enumeration (hardwareConcurrency, deviceMemory).
• Audio & Timezone Spoofing: Adds micro-scale random noise to AudioBuffer APIs to counter acoustic fingerprinting and normalizes the browser timezone output to UTC.
• WebRTC Leak Guard: Restricts non-proxied UDP traffic to prevent real local and public IP address leaks without impairing video conferencing services like Discord or Google Meet.
• Header Hardening: Automatically injects Do Not Track (DNT: 1) and Global Privacy Control (Sec-GPC: 1) headers alongside security enforcement headers (X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN).
• Browser Hardening: Automatically disables network prediction, DNS prefetching, and hyperlink auditing (<a ping>).

firefox-addons:2990053.name: Aar318's Live Translator
firefox-addons:2990053.summary:
Translates Twitch and Kick chat messages in real time, with a configurable target language,
per-message original-text tooltips, a detected source language flag indicator,
and a toggle button injected directly into the chat input bar.
firefox-addons:2990053.description:
🌐 Aar318's Live Translator: Website and Live Chat Translation 
Translate website text, selected passages and unsent drafts into your chosen language. Dedicated Twitch, Kick and YouTube chat controls work alongside a compact overlay for other websites. Translation starts off and is enabled by you.
 🚀 Getting Started 
 Install the extension and click its toolbar icon on an ordinary website. Approve website access if prompted; the permission covers websites together.
 Read the one-time introduction and use the globe to enable translation. On Twitch, Kick and YouTube, clear Also translate page text in the incoming menu if you want chat only.
 Click or right-click the settings gear to choose languages, translation modes, in-page versus overlay controls, and an overlay corner. Other websites always use the overlay.
 Focus a text field and click ⇄ to translate its unsent draft, or select a passage and use Translate selected text . The extension never sends the message for you.
 ✨ New Features (v2.1.0.3) 
 Bug Fix: Stream and video titles that combine writing systems can translate each portion independently, including a Russian subtitle after an English game name. Turning off page translation restores the original title.
 Bug Fix: Incoming translation skips the editable draft and recognizes the freshly posted copy of a translated chat message, including a quick send while the editor settles.
 New Feature: Translate visible page text alongside live chat on Twitch, Kick and YouTube. The incoming translation menu includes an Also translate page text switch. Turn it off to restore surrounding text and keep translating chat.
 Improvement: Page controls are available on streaming pages without a chat toolbar. On YouTube, the watch page and its open live-chat frame respond to the same translation toggle.
 Improvement: Repeated text can share a translation request. Page labels and chat messages are batched separately to improve source-language detection.
 ⭐ Key Features 
 Preference backups: Browser-account sync enabled by default, explicit conflict resolution, portable preference files, and a local safety copy before restores. The backup page identifies excluded saved data.
 Optional TTS Companion: Supply translated chat narration to Live Chat TTS while translation is enabled, with safe original-text fallback when unavailable. 
 Website Translation: Translate safe text blocks and dynamically added text on ordinary websites, or translate a selected passage without replacing page content.
 Saved Overlay Layout: Collapse state and custom dragged position persist across reloads. Overlay layout, corner, collapse and position changes update across open tabs. Use the move handle or its arrow keys; selecting a corner preset clears the custom position. Floating controls fade until hovered or focused.
 Compact or Hidden Controls: Collapse the floating controls to an expand tab, or choose Hidden under Overlay position. The extension icon restores the controls without toggling translation. Hiding and collapsing leave translation running.
 Flexible Placement: Keep dedicated streaming-site controls or use a floating overlay, with four saved corner positions or Hidden.
 Real-Time Translation: Translates visible chat history and newly arriving Twitch, Kick, and YouTube Live messages through Google Translate's public endpoint.
 Automatic, Click, and Hover Modes: Choose continuous translation, translate only clicked messages, or temporarily translate messages while hovering.
 Broad Language Support: Twelve common target languages remain immediately visible, with dozens of additional Google Translate languages under More languages.
 Per-Channel Profiles: Restore languages, mode, automatic outbound behavior, and filters independently for each channel.
 Outbound Draft Translation: Translate an unsent reply independently from incoming chat—even when incoming translation is disabled—using a fixed language or the most recently detected incoming source language.
 Optional Automatic Outbound Translation: Waits for a typing pause, cancels stale drafts, and safely replaces only the draft that still matches the queued text.
 Message Filtering: Optionally skip bots, commands, links, emote-only messages, repeats, selected users, or messages outside chosen length limits.
 Translation Health and Retries: View Ready, Queued, Translating, Throttled, Disabled, or Error state; temporary provider failures use bounded retries.
 Original Text Preserved: Translations retain original message nodes, emotes, spacing, and formatting; translated text can be restored or inspected through its original-text tooltip.
 Translate Selected Text: Select text on a supported page, right-click it, and choose Translate selected text for a compact original/translation result.
 Easy Controls: Left-click toggles incoming translation; right-click or mobile long-press on either control opens its language and settings menu.
 Safe Draft Replacement: Translate a draft, review it in the editor and send it yourself. For up to 12 seconds after sending, the translator can recognize the matching new chat row and preserve its outgoing wording.
 Mobile-Friendly Menus: Touch gestures use stable long-press handling, scrollable choices, viewport clamping, and safe placement around native mobile overlays.
 Optional Page Controls: Hide or restore injected controls from the extension menu. Controls stay out of the way during fullscreen and supported native overlays.
 Efficient Processing: Batches requests and reuses recent translations. Short replies in any supported script qualify by default. Set a minimum or maximum character count under Message filters to limit eligible chat.
 Navigation Resilience: Reconnects observers and controls after Twitch, Kick, or YouTube replaces chat containers or navigates without a full reload.
 🔐 Permissions & Privacy 
 Browser profile sync and preference backups: Eligible preferences sync through your browser account by default. Approve optional sync permissions if prompted. Backup & Restore lets you export preferences, import them with a local safety copy, resolve conflicts or turn sync off. Oversized preferences can still be exported to a file. Page text, chat messages and drafts are excluded from sync. Aar318 does not receive your preferences.
 Alarms: Batches preference changes for browser sync.
 Storage: Saves inbound/outbound language choices, automatic-outbound preference, translation mode, channel profiles, filters, last detected incoming language, and injected-button visibility.
 Active Tab and Scripting: Recover the bundled translator in the page where the extension icon is clicked, including already-open pages after an update or permission grant.
 Context Menus: Adds extension-icon controls and the user-invoked Translate selected text command.
 Host Permissions: Runs on ordinary HTTP/HTTPS websites and allows translation requests to translate.googleapis.com . Website access can be approved together and revoked through extension permissions.
 Translation Data: Only eligible website/chat text, an explicitly selected passage or an unsent draft chosen for translation, together with the target-language code, is sent to Google Translate. Requests omit browser credentials. Password fields are excluded from draft translation; editable fields are excluded from automatic page translation.
 Local Data: Chat messages, selected text, translations, and message-author names are not written to browser storage. Translation caches exist only in memory for the page session.
 No Tracking: No analytics, advertising tracking, or streaming-platform account is required.
Privacy policy: https://gist.github.com/aar318/9d4fc167a12546f162bcef3b91322aad 
 ℹ Notes 
 Protected browser pages, closed shadow roots and arbitrary embedded frames cannot be translated. Automatic website translation targets safe text blocks; use selected-text translation for mixed formatting.
 The introduction appears on the first explicit control interaction and is remembered across future versions. A fresh installation shows it again.
 Incoming translation starts disabled and runs only when the user enables it.
 Automatic outbound translation is off by default. Outbound translation replaces an unsent draft but never sends a chat message automatically.
 If the chat site hides your account name, another viewer’s identical message can be mistaken for your outgoing reply during the 12-second window.
 Translation depends on Google’s availability. A rate limit can leave some text in its original language.

firefox-addons:1002712.name: AInspector for WCAG Accessibility Evaluation
firefox-addons:1002712.summary: Inspects web pages for features and issues related to WCAG 2.2 level A and AA requirements for making web pages more accessible to people with disabilities using web accessibility standards, including WCAG, ARIA and ARIA in HTML specifications.
firefox-addons:1002712.description:
AInspector for Firefox evaluates the accessibility compliance of web pages based on WCAG 2.0, WCAG 2.1 or WCAG 2.2 Level A and AA requirements using OpenA11y Evaluation Library. There is at least one rule in the evaluation library for each Level A and AA requirement. It organizes the evaluation results by Rule Categories and WCAG Guidelines. Evaluation results can be exported in CSV or JSON formats. The tool is designed to help people learn about accessibility requirements, web accessibility standards and the best practices to make website more usable by people with disabilities. Web accessibility standards include the W3C Web Content Accessibility Guidelines Accessible Rich Internet Application (ARIA) specification and the ARIA in HTML specification.
NOTE: The extension does NOT collect any user or evaluation information or require a login for operation.

firefox-addons:3063635.name: Accessibility Report — WCAG & EAA audit
firefox-addons:3063635.summary: Scan any page against WCAG 2.2, then export an accessibility report your client can actually read. Nothing leaves your browser.
firefox-addons:3063635.description:
Turn an accessibility test into a document you can send.
The free tools that check a page for accessibility problems — axe, WAVE, Lighthouse — are built for developers, and they show you developer output. If a client has just asked whether their site is compliant, you cannot forward them a list of rule identifiers.
This extension runs the same class of test, then writes the result in plain English and lays it out as a report: what is wrong, who it shuts out, what to do about it, and which part of the standard it relates to. One click to save it as a PDF.
WHAT YOU GET
· A scan of any page against WCAG 2.2 level AA — the standard named by the European Accessibility Act, and the reference point in US accessibility litigation
· Every finding written in ordinary language, not rule identifiers
· A report laid out to be read by a client, not a build system
· Code locations for whoever does the fixing, which you can leave out of the client's copy
· Findings that a machine cannot settle, listed separately and honestly
WHAT IT WILL NOT TELL YOU
Automated testing finds roughly a third of accessibility problems. It reliably catches what a machine can measure — contrast, missing labels, tap target size. It cannot judge whether alt text is accurate, whether a page still makes sense read aloud in order, or whether someone can get through a checkout using only a keyboard.
So this extension will not tell you a page is compliant, and it does not sell "lawsuit protection". Tools that made those claims have been penalised for it. What it gives you is an accurate, readable starting point, with the parts a person still has to check marked as exactly that.
THREE SEPARATE LISTS, NOT ONE INFLATED NUMBER
· Findings — failures against WCAG 2.2 AA. These are the headline count.
· Also worth fixing — long-established good practice that is not, strictly, a WCAG failure. Counted separately, so the headline number stays true.
· Needs a person to check — cases the test could not settle either way.
NOTHING LEAVES YOUR BROWSER
The test runs on the page in front of you, inside your own browser. Page content, addresses and results are never transmitted. There is no server. No analytics, no tracking, no account, no email required.
The only time the extension contacts the internet at all is if you enter a licence key, and permission for that is requested at that moment — not at install.
FREE AND LICENSED
Everything above is free, including the PDF.
A licence adds your own name and your client's name to the report and removes our sign-off from the footer. That is the whole difference. No findings are withheld from the free version.
Built on axe-core, the open-source rules engine maintained by Deque Systems. Independent product; not affiliated with Deque, the W3C, or any regulator. Not legal advice.

firefox-addons:2876874.name: No Login
firefox-addons:2876874.summary: Access social media websites without logging in: LinkedIn, Instagram, Facebook, X
firefox-addons:2876874.description: Access social media websites without logging in, by removing login popups, bypassing other banners, etc. Currently supported websites: - LinkedIn - Instagram - Facebook - X / Twitter Works on both desktop and mobile. Demo video How it Works: A process, running when the current tab is one of the above websites, periodically checks the page content for login elements. When there is one, it behaves in two different ways: - If there is a button one can click to close it, it clicks it. - If there is no button, it removes the HTML element containing the popup / banner, revealing the desired content behind. Please note that the add-on only modifies the HTML webpage content, so it can only reveal and enhance the user interface. That is, it does not apply any trick, if one even reliably exists, to make the website believe that the user is logged in (via dummy accounts, etc.). As a consequence, the add-on is not able to access some of the logged-in features, such as the LinkedIn user's posts past the 3 most recent ones. Usage: The add-on should work seamlessly upon installation. Privacy and Security Note that the add-on is in its early phase, so it has room for improvement depending on the user needs; see below for the ways to provide feedback. Issue / Bug Report / Feature request: - If you have a GitHub account, open an issue. - Otherwise, write your feedback in this form. Short feedback / comments: Please write a review here. Example feature requests: - Support for additional websites (twitter, quora, reddit, google, etc.) To report bugs, please include enough information to reproduce it on our devices. For instance, you can provide a step-by-step description of the bug, including the visited URLs, localization and language (aka locale, such as en_US), etc.

firefox-addons:3077981.name: Matchday Ticket Overview – Football Tickets
firefox-addons:3077981.summary: Shows free football (soccer) tickets live on the seat map: seats, standing and total with crests and kick-off time – in the official ticket shops of 450+ clubs in 18 countries, from the Premier League, LaLiga and Serie A to the Bundesliga.
firefox-addons:3077981.description:
Matchday Ticket Overview shows you live how many football tickets are still available – right on the seat map of the official ticket shop. Seats, standing and total at a glance, without clicking through every block and without constant reloading. For 450+ clubs in 18 countries, from the Premier League to the Bundesliga.
 What you see 
- available seats, standing places and the total number of tickets
- home and away crests plus match date and kick-off time
- when it was last updated – live in many shops while the seat map is open
- in some shops, the listings of the club's official resale platform too
- a small overlay you can drag or close, styled in the shop's colours, in English or German (following your browser language)
 What it's for 
Find the last remaining tickets, keep an eye on returns and new releases, and see at once whether a match is close to sold out and whether seats or standing tickets are left – for home and away games, cup ties, European nights and women's football.
 Supported clubs (examples – 450+ in total) 
- England: every Premier League club, plus the Championship, League One, League Two and National League
- Germany: every club in the Bundesliga, 2. Bundesliga, 3. Liga and Frauen-Bundesliga, plus many lower-league clubs – e.g. Borussia Dortmund, FC Bayern München, FC Schalke 04, Hamburger SV
- Spain: LaLiga, Segunda División, Primera Federación – e.g. Sevilla FC, Real Betis, Athletic Club
- Italy: Serie A, Serie B, Serie C – e.g. Inter, Lazio
- Austria: every Bundesliga club – e.g. Rapid Wien, Sturm Graz
- Switzerland: Super League and Challenge League – e.g. FC Basel, Young Boys
- Also many top-flight clubs in France, the Netherlands, Belgium, Portugal, Scotland, Poland, Denmark, Norway, Finland, the Czech Republic, Slovakia and Hungary
 Works with 
seat maps from Eventim, Ticket-Onlineshop, oeticket, Ticketcorner and TicketOne, and club shops running on Ticketmaster, SecuTix, Reservix, vivenu, seats.io , Roboticket, Vivaticket, TicketCo, Tymes4 and many other systems.
 How it works 
1. Install the extension – no settings, no account.
2. Open the seat map for a match in your club's ticket shop.
3. The overlay appears as soon as the shop has loaded availability.
 Privacy 
No tracking, no ads, no data sent anywhere. The extension only reads what the ticket shop loads anyway, makes no requests of its own and is only active on the supported ticket shop pages.
Notes: some clubs only show the seat map after login or to members – the overlay appears as soon as you can see the seat map. If a shop doesn't separate seats and standing, the overlay shows the total. In Firefox you may need to allow access to the ticket shop in the extensions menu.
Unofficial, independent project – not affiliated with the clubs, leagues, ticket shops or ticketing providers mentioned. All trademarks belong to their respective owners.

firefox-addons:2937565.name: Per-Tab Volume Control
firefox-addons:2937565.summary: Controls audio volume for individual tabs up to 500%
firefox-addons:2937565.description:
Take full control of your browser's audio. Whether a video is too quiet, poorly mixed, too loud in places, or you want better control across multiple tabs, Per-Tab Volume Control gives you the tools to fix it instantly.
 🚀 Key Features 
- 🔊 500% Volume Boost: Blast past the system limit. Perfect for quiet YouTube videos, low-volume podcasts, online meetings, and streams that are just too faint.
- 🎛 Smart Audio Compressor: Automatically balances audio levels. It lowers loud explosions and boosts quiet dialogue, so you do not have to constantly reach for the volume knob.
- 🔇 Mute, Mono and L/R Balance: Instantly mute the current tab, force mono audio, or shift sound left and right directly from the main popup.
- ⌨ Keyboard Shortcuts: Adjust volume, reset volume, mute or unmute, and toggle compressor on the active tab without opening the popup.
- 🎯 Cross-Tab Audio Control: Manage volume, mute, and compressor settings for all tabs with active audio from one convenient panel.
- 🌍 Global Audio Defaults: Set Compressor and Mono defaults for newly opened or reloaded pages, and use Global L/R Balance across open tabs and new pages while enabled.
- 🗣 Multilanguage Support: Switch the popup language from Settings: English, Spanish, German, French, Russian, or Simplified Chinese.
- ✅ Per-Tab Isolation: Adjust one tab without affecting the others. Listen to music in the background while watching a tutorial at a different volume.
- 🌐 Broad Compatibility: Works on most websites with HTML5 audio and video, including YouTube, Twitch, Spotify, Netflix, and more.
- 🔒 Privacy First: Runs 100% locally on your machine. No tracking, no data collection, no ads.
 💡 How to Use the Audio Compressor 
Think of the compressor as an automatic volume assistant. It smooths out the difference between the loudest and quietest parts of a video, making quiet dialogue easier to hear without being blasted by sudden loud sounds.
 Turn it On: Toggle the Compressor switch in the popup.
 Threshold (Sensitivity): 
- Lower sensitivity (for example, -10dB): Compression only kicks in for the loudest peaks, leaving most audio untouched.
- Higher sensitivity (for example, -40dB): Compression reacts to much more of the audio, helping with whispering dialogue or inconsistent podcast levels.
- Default (-18dB): A balanced starting point for most content.
 Ratio (Strength): 
- Low (2:1): Gentle, subtle leveling with a more natural sound.
- Medium (6:1 - Default): Balanced compression for everyday listening.
- High (12:1): Strong limiting that pulls loud and quiet sounds closer together. Great for late-night watching.
 🔒 Privacy and Permissions 
This extension prioritizes your privacy. It runs 100% locally on your machine and does not collect, store, or transmit any browsing data.
 Why "Access your data for all websites"? 
You may see a permission warning asking to "Access your data for all websites". This is not used to track you. It is required for the extension's always-on features:
- Seamless Player Sync: Automatically detects media players as soon as you open a tab, helping the popup stay in sync with the page.
- Instant Control: Lets the extension work immediately without manually activating it on every tab.
 Is this permission mandatory? 
 No. If you prefer stricter privacy, you can restrict the extension's access in your browser settings.
- If Enabled (Default): The extension works automatically on every tab.
- If Disabled: The extension becomes click-to-activate and will only work after you manually open it on that page.

firefox-addons:2605099.name: MONKNOW New Tab - Personal Dashboard
firefox-addons:2605099.summary: The new tab page you've been dreaming of, with grouped website links, real-time cloud sync, and a dark theme.
firefox-addons:2605099.description:
Overview
MONKNOW is a customizable browser new tab extension that brings your favorite websites, search, wallpapers, weather, and to-do list together in one place. Organize icons and the page appearance your way, then back up and sync your data through an account to restore it on other devices or in other browser environments.
Key features
• Search and quick access
Search directly from a new tab or open your favorite websites quickly with website icons. Choose, arrange, and manage search engines, or add custom search engines.
• Website icons and groups
Keep your favorite websites organized. Create, edit, and arrange icons and groups to find the sites you want to visit quickly. When adding a website, choose an icon from the official icon library, upload a custom image, or, with your permission, find an icon from the website. Choose between Simple and Detailed display modes, and adjust the layout and appearance.
• Bookmark import
Bring existing bookmarks into your new tab. Choose what to import; this feature is available only after you grant permission.
• Appearance and wallpapers
Make your new tab fit your preferences. Choose light, dark, or system theme mode; use official wallpapers, upload local images, set a solid-color background, or configure wallpaper rotation.
• Weather, to-do list, and sidebar
Check weather information and manage your to-do list from the sidebar, and show or hide sidebar content as needed.
• Standby page
Show a standby page when you are away. Customize its clock, weather, background, and other appearance settings.
• Account, backup, and sync
Use MONKNOW as a guest, or create an account or sign in. When signed in, MONKNOW can back up and sync extension data to your account, so you can restore and use it on other devices or in other browser environments.
Permissions
Browser API permissions
• storage (required)
Stores your icons, groups, wallpaper preferences, search settings, to-do list, and other extension settings locally in your browser.
• tabs (required)
When you use Quick Add from the extension toolbar, reads the title and URL of the current tab so you can add the website as an icon. It is also used to open the links and search results you choose. It is not used to track your browsing history.
• alarms (required)
Runs the extension's scheduled background tasks, including data synchronization when applicable.
• search (required)
Uses the browser search engine you choose when you search.
• bookmarks (optional)
Reads your bookmark folders and content only after you choose to import bookmarks and grant permission. MONKNOW does not read bookmarks without your permission.
Host permissions
• *. monknow.com (required)
Connects to MONKNOW account and cloud services, including sign-in, data backup, synchronization, and related service requests.
• All HTTP and HTTPS websites (optional)
Only after you choose to find an image for a website icon and grant permission, accesses the website address you enter to find icon or image candidates provided by that website. It is not used to monitor the pages you browse.
• suggestqueries.google.com ; api.bing.com ; suggestion.baidu.com (optional)
Used to retrieve search suggestions from Google, Bing or Baidu. Only after you select the corresponding service and grant access are the keywords you enter sent to that service to retrieve suggestions.
Privacy policy and terms of use

Terms of use: https://www.monknow.com/terms-of-use

For questions, suggestions, or help, email: help@monknow.com

apple-macos:6792892065.name: Reeltone: Music for Jellyfin
apple-macos:6792892065.description:
Reeltone turns your Jellyfin server into a native iPhone and iPad music player — background playback that keeps going when you lock the phone, offline downloads, lock-screen and Control Center controls, AirPlay, and synced lyrics.
Point it at your server, sign in, and your whole library is in your pocket.
WHAT YOU GET
• True background audio — music keeps playing when you leave the app or lock your phone. No more silence when the screen turns off.
• Lock screen & Control Center — play, pause, skip, and scrub without opening the app. Album art on your lock screen.
• Offline downloads — save albums and tracks and play them with no connection, on a plane or underground.
• Synced lyrics — sing along line by line, pulled from your server or fetched automatically from LRCLIB when your server has none.
• AirPlay — send audio to HomePod, Apple TV, or any AirPlay speaker.
• Fast, native browsing — artists, albums, playlists, and search, with a library that loads instantly and works offline.
• A retro cassette-deck look — tape reels that spin as you listen and a waveform you can scrub.
REQUIREMENTS
Reeltone connects to your own Jellyfin server (jellyfin.org) — a free, open-source media server you host yourself. You'll need a server and an account on it. For lyrics, Jellyfin 10.9 or newer is recommended.
Reeltone is an independent client and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Jellyfin project.
